market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $130 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Settlement basis: WTI front-month settling at 30 requires ~23% rally in 2 months from 06. Even Goldman/EIA upper bounds for Q2/H2 2026 fall short of 30 absent major escalation. Tail risk only.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Major war escalation or supply shock.
